text:
Ria: Quick opinion on the model catalog row mock I posted: https://redwood.mock/row/compact-v6. Two decisions: chip collapse behavior and badge wording (surface vs tooltip).
Oleg: For chips, show up to 3 inline then collapse into a focusable '+N' trigger. Keeps density. '+N' must be keyboard reachable and announce items when opened.
Mina: Agree. Also the '+N' should have aria-expanded and move focus into a small list with checkbox-like controls. aria-bot can confirm pattern.
accessibility-bot: Pattern rec: use role="button" with aria-haspopup="listbox" and aria-expanded toggled. On open, set focus to the first item, and populate an aria-live="polite" string: 'Filters: quantized, short-context'. Return focus to trigger on close.
Ria: Badge surface: propose '120 ms' as the visible label, with a subtle 'typ.' microtag. Keep p50/p95 and sample size in the tooltip. Avoid 'p50' on surface.
Oleg: Also add an icon (clock) next to the badge so color isn't the only signal. Ensure contrast for small type.
Mina: Pin copy should be explicit: modal title 'Pin model version for project' and body includes 'Version ID: v12.3' and fallback note. Show a small 'Pinned' chip in the row with aria-label 'Pinned for project'.
Dev: I'll update the Figma and add keyboard screenshots. ETA EOD, will add tickets for engineering with acceptance criteria.
Ria: Great, thanks — we'll roll this into the sprint planning. :white_check_mark:
